speaker: Doctor
text: Let me clarify your symptoms: Did this sudden vertigo occur while you were lying down, or did it start when you moved your head? Also, have you experienced any hearing loss, ringing in your ears, or severe headache alongside the spinning sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor

That is a very brief duration for true vertigo; did the spinning sensation stop completely when you stopped moving your head, and did you experience any difficulty walking or double vision during those three minutes? I also need to know if you have a history of high blood pressure, diabetes, or prior strokes.
